title: Sensei Governed Evaluator Composition Evaluation Receipt V1
description: O4's own closed evidence document binding the entire evaluation composition without replacing O1's synthesis.Evaluation or terminal synthesis.Receipt. Records exactly how far one evaluation composition progressed via a closed, six-value disposition, referencing the generation handoff, policy, evaluator results, and O1's own terminal-receipt digest without altering any of them.
$comment: Canonical producer/owner: globulario/sensei, golang/architecture/evaluatorcomposition. Per docs/design/governed-evaluator-composition-o4.md's disposition/evidence-presence matrix and hard law 21 (no disposition without an O1-recorded consequence): session_digest_sha256, attempt_digest_sha256, runner_receipt_digest_sha256, request_digest_sha256, result_digest_sha256, o2_receipt_digest_sha256, policy_digest_sha256, candidate_artifact_digest_sha256, and disposition are present on every disposition (laws 1-9 validate before the first Transition call). The remaining fields' presence is exactly this matrix, encoded below as allOf conditionals -- see the design doc's two disposition tables for the authoritative source this schema mirrors.

policy_digest_sha256.$comment: Always present -- policy validates as a precondition alongside generation-handoff validation, before the first Transition call (law 9), so its digest is never conditional on how far past that call O4 gets.

candidate_artifact_digest_sha256.$comment: Always present as a reference from the O3 receipt; candidate_artifact_verified states whether it was additionally loaded and cross-bound.

evaluator_result_bindings.$comment: Must be sorted in strictly ascending evaluator_id order with no duplicate evaluator_id (enforced in Go, not schema-expressible over a variable-length array) -- see ValidateEvaluationReceipt. Must be empty for invalid-output-terminated and candidate-load-failure (no evaluator surface was ever constructed); may be any length, including empty, for every other disposition.

failure_detail.$comment: Required non-empty exactly when disposition is not evaluated; empty when evaluated.

cleanup_succeeded.$comment: Nil for invalid-output-terminated and candidate-load-failure (no evaluator surface was ever constructed); a non-nil boolean for every other disposition.

cleanup_failure_detail.$comment: Required non-empty exactly when cleanup_succeeded is false; empty when cleanup_succeeded is null or true.

completed_at.$comment: Observation timestamp, explicitly excluded from receipt_digest_sha256 so receipt identity does not depend on wall-clock time.

receipt_digest_sha256.$comment: Self-referential semantic digest of this document with this field zeroed before hashing.

allOf.$comment: invalid-output-terminated, candidate-load-failure: no evaluator surface was ever constructed.

materialization-failure, required-evaluator-unavailable, composition-failure: the candidate was loaded and at least one evaluator surface was constructed; composition never reached a valid Evaluation.

evaluated: a valid O1 Evaluation was composed. o1_terminal_receipt_digest_sha256 is deliberately NOT constrained here -- it is present only when the resulting O1 phase is terminal (PhaseSucceeded/PhaseFailed) and absent when RecordEvaluationCommand hands the session to PhaseRetry/PhaseReplan; that is a runtime fact this schema cannot decide from the receipt's own fields alone.
